name: Seezee (Gimm sisters)
description: Seezee was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid employed as a tutor droid at the Gimm sisters' orphanage in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY. Around that time, Seezee was already an old unit, with its servos whining as it moved about.
